delete_insert_where_01.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query section 4.1.1.1 and RFC 3986 section 5.1 (with no BASE the base IRI is set by the application)
delete_insert_where_01.note:
The update uses relative IRIs (,

) with no BASE; Jena resolves them against its system base, the engine refuses them (parse error). Jena's DatasetGraphWrapper counts add() calls; an update reaches the dataset through the engine, so the count would not match either.
